title: science entity base profile (kind-agnostic; mixins pin identity)
$comment: Base 1.0 enum-locks `kind` and prefix-locks `id` to the four commons kinds. Composition is a pure allOf, which can only NARROW, so no mixin can widen them and project-authored kinds cannot be expressed under 1.0 at all. This base constrains shape only; each mixin supplies the exact `kind` const. Commons records stay pinned to 1.0 — two base versions coexisting is what versioning is for.

schema_profile.$comment: Optional here, and DERIVED for project kinds (`default_profile_for_kind`). It stays declared because commons records — which travel between repos, so the profile must travel with the record — legitimately author it. A project kind's mixin sets this to `false`.

id.$comment: Prefix-agnostic. The suffix is widened to 127 chars because real hypothesis slugs exceed base 1.0's 64 (e.g. `0009-local-structure-globalization-obstruction`).

kind.$comment: Shape only. The mixin's `const` pins the exact kind — so adding a new kind never edits this versioned file.

version.$comment: Optional here, and a COMMONS concept: semver on a shared record. A project entity is versioned by its repo's git history. A project kind's mixin sets this to `false`.
